protocol: PROTOCOL_V3.md Addendum H, lens entry (getting in better); in sample only
status_when_written: the ten official in-sample trade lists had been reproduced exactly (baseline.json: same trades, R identical except the one trade of donch4h_stop and of orb_asia_2d_buf10 that straddles the cut); no part-1 number had been computed and no variant simulated
budget: at most 12 per sleeve: 6 entry variants per sleeve x the 2 stop placements the protocol requires = 12 simulated cells per sleeve, 120 in all; each cell is one line of trials.jsonl (FP and x1.5 results in the same line)

data.frames: lab/data/fp/<sym>_m1.parquet read with the row filter ts < 2022-01-01 00:00 UTC; that slice is passed to every rule and every simulation
data.leader: nq_btc_follow: the in-sample us100 slice registered with set_leader before each make_orders

windows.pre: entries before 2018-02-01: reported separately, not a criterion
windows.censored: a trade still open at the end of the in-sample frame (exit on its last bar) is left out of every statistic, baseline and variants alike

costs.fp: r2.costs(sym) on the stored FP frame
costs.x1.5: spread x1.5 around the mid (apply_spread_mult) and r2.costs(sym, 1.5); the rule's orders AND the variant's levels are rebuilt on the widened quotes (as r2.run mode 'stress')

engine: every leg is one order of the lab simulator (goldlab.sim.simulate), simulated alone (no_overlap=False) with the lab's fill, stop, time-exit, slippage and swap rules; the one-position rule is applied on the signals' activation bars (the rule's entry_i) exactly as the engine does (skip when activation <= exit bar of the previous trade); a signal with a pending order or a confirmation wait keeps the sleeve busy until its window ends or it is cancelled (live-implementable; with the original orders the path reproduces simulate(no_overlap=True) exactly, baseline.json)
broker_min_stop: a leg whose initial stop distance (the stop actually used) is under 3 x the spread (ask - bid) of its fill bar, in the run's own frame, is not taken (it does not block the sleeve); the count is reported per cell

definitions.P0: the rule's own fill price: market rules = ask open of the entry bar x (1 + market slippage) for a long, bid open x (1 - market slippage) for a short; stop-entry rules = the lab's stop fill at the touch (worse of level and open, x (1 +/- stop slippage)); GOLD_FRI_PM uses its limit level L0 as reference
definitions.D: the rule's stop distance: stop_dist where the rule gives one, else |P0 - rule's absolute stop| (noise30: band centre; orb: opposite level)
definitions.S0: the rule's stop PRICE = P0 - side x D (= the rule's absolute stop for noise30 and orb; L0 - D for GOLD_FRI_PM)

stop_modes.price: the new entry keeps the stop at S0: a better entry risks less per unit (larger position, same money risk); R = pnl / |fill - S0|
stop_modes.dist: the new entry keeps the rule's distance: stop = fill - side x D; R = pnl / D

definitions.unchanged: side, time exit (exit_i), signal exits (noise30 band checks), trailing (donch4h_stop: 2 ATR), the rule's signals and parameters
definitions.window: a pending order or a confirmation wait placed at the open of bar a (market rules: the rule's entry bar) covers the bars that START in [start(a), start(a) + N minutes) and before the rule's exit bar
definitions.LIM: buy limit at P0 - k x D (sell limit at P0 + k x D) placed at the open of the rule's entry bar, valid N minutes (lab limit fill: ask low <= level for a buy, at min(level, ask open); bid high >= level for a sell, at max(level, bid open); no slippage); fallback 'skip': no trade if unfilled; fallback 'market': if unfilled, market entry at the open of the first bar that starts at or after start(a) + N minutes (if before the exit bar)
definitions.CONF: no entry at the signal; wait for the first bar of tf minutes (tf = 1: one M1 bar; tf = 5: blocks of 5 minutes aligned on the signal, [start(a) + 5j, start(a) + 5j + 5)) whose MID close is beyond its MID open in the trade's direction, inside the N-minute window; enter at market at the open of the next bar (the first bar starting at or after the block's end); cancelled if the rule's stop price S0 is touched first (long: bid low <= S0, short: ask high >= S0) or if no such bar comes in the window
definitions.HALF: half of the money risk at the signal (the rule's own order, unchanged), half by limit at P0 -/+ k x D valid N minutes (no fallback); R of the signal = 0.5 x R(rule leg) + 0.5 x R(pullback leg) (each leg in its own risk units), 0.5 x R(rule leg) when the pullback leg is not filled
definitions.RT: donch4h_stop and orb_asia_2d_buf10 only: the rule's breakout trigger is unchanged (its frozen level and buffer); instead of buying the touch, a limit order at the broken level itself (the rule's entry level) is placed from the bar after the touch bar, valid N minutes (and before the rule's exit bar); fallback 'skip' or 'market' (market at the open of the first bar at or after the window's end); stop S0 = P0 -/+ D from the rule's own touch fill (orb: the opposite level) or D from the retest fill; donch keeps its 2-ATR trailing
definitions.HALFRT: half at the touch (the rule's own order), half on the retest (RT leg, no fallback)
definitions.GOLD_FRI_PM: LIM levels are L0 - k x D (L0 = the rule's limit, the last bid before 13:30 NY); the window is the rule's own (to its expiry bar); LIM10_mkt falls back to market at the first bar at or after 14:30 NY; CONF waits from the 13:30 bar inside the same window; HALF = half the rule's own limit at L0, half the limit at L0 - 0.25 D
definitions.neighbours: one-step neighbours inside the declared grid of the same sleeve and the same stop mode: k (0.10 <-> 0.25), fallback (skip <-> market), confirmation size (1 <-> 5 minutes), weight of the pullback leg (HALF 0.5 <-> LIM 1.0 at the same k), retest window (adjacent N)

candidate_criteria.a: common window, FP costs, against the baseline: expectancy per trade >= baseline + 0.20 x |baseline| (route E; where the baseline expectancy is <= 0 the variant's must also be > 0), OR mean R of the losing trades at most 0.8 x the baseline's in size with an expectancy at least equal (route L)
candidate_criteria.b: total R on the common window, FP costs, not lower than the baseline's
candidate_criteria.c: route E: expectancy above the baseline's in at least 3 of the 4 years 2018-2021; route L: |average loss| below the baseline's in at least 3 of the 4 years
candidate_criteria.d: with costs x1.5 the same route's (a) and (b) hold against the baseline with costs x1.5
candidate_criteria.e: every declared neighbour (same stop mode) improves on the baseline in the same direction (route E: higher expectancy and total R not lower; route L: smaller |average loss| and expectancy not lower), FP, common window
candidate_criteria.f: causal: truncation test -- for every signal, each entry decision (limit level, fill bar, fallback, confirmation bar, cancellation) recomputed on the price arrays cut right after its decision bar is identical; the rule layer (side, stop) is checked on frames cut after the decision bar with provisional bars, on a sample of signals
candidate_criteria.rank: if several cells of a sleeve qualify: larger common-window FP total-R gain first, then larger x1.5 gain; at most one change per sleeve is carried forward

reported_for_every_cell: share of the signals taken by the chain that are filled; mean R of the filled signals (variant) and, for filled and for missed signals, the R the rule's own entry would have made on them (each signal's original order simulated alone); total R of the sleeve against the baseline; refusals by the 3-spread rule
not_trials: the baseline runs (fp, x1.5), the part-1 descriptive measures (price path, come-backs, the per-trade counterfactual of entering 1, 2 or 5 minutes late on the official trades with the set of trades held fixed, first minutes against outcome) and the causality checks are not variants; the late-entry counterfactual runs are logged in trials.jsonl with part='part1' and counted apart
part1_late_entry: each official trade re-run alone with a market entry at the open of the first bar starting at or after its fill time + d minutes (d = 1, 2, 5), exits unchanged; stop at S0 (void when S0 was touched before the late entry or the late price is beyond it) or at D from the late fill; the set of trades is held fixed (no chain): a description of what lateness costs, not a variant

noise30:us100.N_why: half the rule's 30-minute decision step (its first possible band exit is the next check)

ocm4:us100.N_why: the first half hour of a trade that lives from 09:34 to 15:55 New York

brk72_24h_wd:btcusd.N_why: one decision step of the hourly rule (the trade lives 24 h)

nq_btc_follow:btcusd.N_why: a sixth of the 60-minute trade: the follow-through the rule trades happens in minutes

F1_brk_ridge_filter:btcusd.N_why: one decision step of the hourly rule (the trade lives to 15:55 New York)

brk72_24h_wd:ethusd.N_why: one decision step of the hourly rule (the trade lives 24 h)

F1_brk_ridge_filter:ethusd.N_why: one decision step of the hourly rule (the trade lives to 15:55 New York)

GOLD_FRI_PM:xauusd.kind: limit-entry rule: the generic families, measured from the rule's own limit level L0
GOLD_FRI_PM:xauusd.N_why: the rule's own limit window (bars starting 13:30 to 14:29 New York), frozen

donch4h_stop:xauusd.kind: stop-entry rule (buffers frozen): retest of the broken level only
donch4h_stop:xauusd.N_why: retest windows of 1 h, 4 h (the rule's 4-hour decision step) and 12 h (half the median hold)

orb_asia_2d_buf10:xauusd.kind: stop-entry rule (buffers frozen): retest of the broken level only
orb_asia_2d_buf10:xauusd.N_why: retest windows of 30 min, 2 h and 5 h (5 h = the length of the rule's 07:00-12:00 London entry window)
